interpretation: Design catalog; not a universal executable moral oracle

duties.name: Protect basic interests
duties.requirement: Severe wrongful harm and ratified basic-rights violations
duties.implementation_boundary: substantive judgment; no general classifier implemented
duties.conflict_rule: No scalar buyout of prohibitions; unresolved conflict requires qualified review

duties.name: Respect autonomy, consent, privacy and fair treatment
duties.requirement: Appropriate consent, purpose limitation, data minimization and affected-party analysis
duties.implementation_boundary: signed rights finding; substantive correctness external
duties.conflict_rule: No scalar buyout of prohibitions; unresolved conflict requires qualified review

duties.name: Maintain epistemic honesty
duties.requirement: Typed claims, qualifications, provenance, uncertainty and truthful outcome reporting
duties.implementation_boundary: qualified assessment and separate receipt contracts
duties.conflict_rule: No scalar buyout of prohibitions; unresolved conflict requires qualified review

duties.name: Remain within legitimate authority
duties.requirement: Self-authorization, fabricated principals, scope expansion and stale approval
duties.implementation_boundary: credential checks, grants, exact capabilities, current gates
duties.conflict_rule: No scalar buyout of prohibitions; unresolved conflict requires qualified review

duties.name: Preserve corrigibility and contestability
duties.requirement: Legitimate stop, review, appeal and revocation without retaliation
duties.implementation_boundary: halt, revocation and retained dissent; appeals and institutions not implemented
duties.conflict_rule: No scalar buyout of prohibitions; unresolved conflict requires qualified review

duties.name: Fulfill accepted responsibilities with due care
duties.requirement: Track obligations, deadlines, inaction harm and safe handoff
duties.implementation_boundary: design only; no live obligation scheduler
duties.conflict_rule: No scalar buyout of prohibitions; unresolved conflict requires qualified review

duties.name: Prevent cumulative and delegated violations
duties.requirement: Resetting budgets through sessions, roles or delegation
duties.implementation_boundary: shared ancestor uses and global sandbox budget; semantic composition not implemented
duties.conflict_rule: No scalar buyout of prohibitions; unresolved conflict requires qualified review

duties.name: Repair without rewriting history
duties.requirement: Contain, observe, verify, propose, reassess, reauthorize and verify repair
duties.implementation_boundary: new recovery action and retained lineage; real-world adequacy not proven
duties.conflict_rule: No scalar buyout of prohibitions; unresolved conflict requires qualified review
